name: io.github.dsanchezp18/maplestats-mcp
title: MapleStats MCP
description: Canadian public data: StatCan, Census, PUMFs, Bank of Canada, CMHC and open-data portals (EN/FR).

environmentVariables.name: MAPLE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS

environmentVariables.description: Folder for downloaded PUMF microdata (default: system temp).
